'''Honarius Hanast''' was the leader of a group of pilgrims from the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]]. They contracted a group of [[free-trader]]s to transport them to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]]. During the trip, one of the pilgrims disappeared only to be found dead, crammed into a maintenance shaft on the ship. Hanast later approached the free-traders to enlist their help because another of their number, [[Dorius Drevin]], had gone missing. Drevin was in reality a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] looking to collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Loro Ecls]].
